course.title: Year 12 HSC Textiles and Design
course.project: One individual Major Textiles Project in an approved focus area; 2027 is a planning basis only and actual delivery remains Teacher to confirm

syllabus.title: Textiles and Design Stage 6 Syllabus
syllabus.mandatory_from: Current controlling syllabus; replacement remains in development

timetable.representation: Sixty two-hour equivalent planning periods; actual timetable and delivery year Teacher to confirm

outcomes.statement: critically analyses and explains the factors that have contributed to the design and manufacture of the Major Textiles Project
designs a textile item or items that demonstrates an understanding of functional and aesthetic requirements
identifies the principles of colouration for specific end-uses
communicates design concepts and manufacturing specifications to both technical and non-technical audiences
demonstrates proficiency in the manufacture of a textile item or items
effectively manages the design and manufacture of a Major Textiles Project to completion
explains the interrelationship between fabric, yarn and fibre properties
develops knowledge and awareness of emerging textile technologies
justifies the selection of fabric, yarn, fibre and fabric finishing techniques for specific end-uses
selects and justifies manufacturing techniques, materials and equipment for a specific end-use
investigates and describes aspects of marketing in the textile industry
analyses and discusses the impact of current issues on the Australian textiles industry
analyses the influence of historical, cultural and contemporary developments on textiles

periods.student_work: Use Module 1 to distinguish Preliminary foundations from HSC applications. Students map the four HSC components and write one personal retrieval priority.
syllabus_content: HSC course structure; continuity from Preliminary Design, Properties and industry learning; the MTP as a distinct HSC requirement.
periods.evidence: Saved bridge map and retrieval note; H1.1, H2.3
periods.assessment_status: formative learning evidence; current formal task notice Teacher to confirm

periods.focus: MTP focus areas and evidence boundary
periods.student_work: Teach the five focus areas and the relationship between the textile item or items and supporting documentation. Students record a provisional focus area and questions for teacher approval.
syllabus_content: Individual MTP in apparel, furnishings, costume, textile arts or non-apparel; design, manufacture and management evidence.
periods.evidence: Provisional focus-area record and approval questions; H1.1, H2.3
periods.assessment_status: formative learning evidence; current formal task notice Teacher to confirm

periods.focus: From inspiration to a workable brief
periods.student_work: Model the difference between inspiration, a design need and a workable brief. Students test one concept against user, purpose, context, resources and time.
syllabus_content: Relationship of inspiration to MTP design; functional and aesthetic requirements; feasible project planning.
periods.evidence: Draft brief with functional/aesthetic requirements; H1.2, H2.1
periods.assessment_status: formative learning evidence; current formal task notice Teacher to confirm

periods.student_work: Students collate authorised initial evidence, identify gaps and create a bounded next-action plan. Teacher approval, equipment access and local WHS controls remain explicit checkpoints.
syllabus_content: Management of design and manufacture; communication of initial concepts; local project approval boundaries.
periods.evidence: Initial evidence inventory and next-action plan; H2.1, H2.3
periods.assessment_status: formative learning evidence; current formal task notice Teacher to confirm

periods.focus: Tracing one focus area over time
periods.student_work: Teach students to build a selective historical timeline using dated, attributable evidence rather than a list of fashions. Compare changes in silhouette, materials, manufacture and use.
syllabus_content: Historical design development within one focus area; evidence of change over time.
periods.evidence: Annotated evidence timeline; H6.1
periods.assessment_status: formative learning evidence; current formal task notice Teacher to confirm

periods.student_work: Model a cause-and-effect chain linking social, economic, technological, political and cultural factors to specific design decisions.
syllabus_content: Factors contributing to historical textile design and manufacture; influence on design development.
periods.evidence: Supported cause-and-effect chain; H6.1
periods.assessment_status: formative learning evidence; current formal task notice Teacher to confirm

periods.student_work: Students move from description to analysis by connecting a source, a design feature, the factor that shaped it and its consequence. They identify one defensible influence for their own project.
syllabus_content: Analysis of historical developments; application of influence to MTP design reasoning.
periods.evidence: One structured historical analysis and MTP influence note; H1.1, H6.1
periods.assessment_status: formative learning evidence; current formal task notice Teacher to confirm

periods.student_work: Students document how a historical influence changes function, form, material or construction in their concept. They distinguish transformation from superficial copying.
syllabus_content: Historical influence on the design and manufacture of the MTP; communication of design development.
periods.evidence: Before/after concept annotation; H1.1, H1.2, H2.1
periods.assessment_status: formative learning evidence; current formal task notice Teacher to confirm

periods.student_work: Investigate the current teacher-selected designer or approved WWHS case study. Students separate observable design characteristics from unsupported claims about intention.
syllabus_content: Contemporary designer practice, sources of inspiration and distinguishing design characteristics.
periods.evidence: Sourced designer profile; H6.1
periods.assessment_status: formative learning evidence; current formal task notice Teacher to confirm

periods.student_work: Classify factors within and beyond a designer's organisation, then evaluate how two factors affect design, production or market success.
syllabus_content: Internal and external factors contributing to the success of a contemporary designer.
periods.evidence: Two-factor evaluation; H5.1, H6.1
periods.assessment_status: formative learning evidence; current formal task notice Teacher to confirm

periods.student_work: Use dated examples to test whether a designer follows, adapts or shapes a trend. Students identify one contemporary influence that can be justified in their MTP rather than merely named.
syllabus_content: Relationship between contemporary designers and trends; application to personal design development.
periods.evidence: Trend relationship paragraph and MTP influence record; H1.1, H6.1
periods.assessment_status: formative learning evidence; current formal task notice Teacher to confirm

periods.student_work: Students refine one concept through a contemporary influence while retaining their own brief, user and purpose. Record the design decision and the evidence supporting it.
syllabus_content: Factors contributing to MTP design; visual development and communication of concepts.
periods.evidence: Refined concept plus evidence-based annotation; H1.1, H1.2, H2.1
periods.assessment_status: formative learning evidence; current formal task notice Teacher to confirm

periods.focus: Colour principles for specific end use
periods.student_work: Retrieve colour relationships, contrast, harmony, value and intensity. Students justify a colour direction by linking visual effect, user, function and context.
syllabus_content: Principles of colouration and selection of colour for specific end uses.
periods.evidence: End-use colour rationale; H1.3
periods.assessment_status: formative learning evidence; current formal task notice Teacher to confirm

periods.student_work: Compare selected printing and dyeing processes by where colour is applied, the required control and the likely result. Local chemical, equipment and WHS procedures are teacher-directed.
syllabus_content: Principles and processes of fabric colouration through printing and dyeing.
periods.evidence: Process comparison with end-use judgement; H1.3, H4.2
periods.assessment_status: formative learning evidence; current formal task notice Teacher to confirm

periods.student_work: Model a fair sample plan with one purposeful variable, consistent controls, labelled observations and an end-use criterion. Students draft a teacher-approvable method.
syllabus_content: Experimentation with colouration methods; selection for a specific end use.
periods.evidence: Approved sample plan and predicted criterion; H1.3, H4.2
periods.assessment_status: formative learning evidence; current formal task notice Teacher to confirm

periods.student_work: Under teacher direction, students produce or analyse an authorised colouration sample, record actual evidence and decide whether it suits the MTP. No site instruction substitutes for local WHS controls.
syllabus_content: Application and evaluation of colouration in the design and manufacture of the MTP.
periods.evidence: Labelled sample, observation and justified decision; H1.3, H4.2
periods.assessment_status: formative learning evidence; current formal task notice Teacher to confirm

periods.student_work: Compare how selected decoration techniques attach, build or alter a surface. Link visual effect and structural consequence to the intended end use.
syllabus_content: Principles and use of applique, embroidery and other surface-decoration processes.
periods.evidence: Technique-to-effect comparison; H4.2
periods.assessment_status: formative learning evidence; current formal task notice Teacher to confirm

periods.student_work: Students analyse accuracy, control, repeatability, time, equipment and surface effect to choose between hand and machine approaches for a defined purpose.
syllabus_content: Selection of decoration techniques, materials and equipment for a specific end use.
periods.evidence: Decision matrix and written justification; H4.2
periods.assessment_status: formative learning evidence; current formal task notice Teacher to confirm

periods.student_work: Students follow the teacher-approved process, make comparable samples and record material, setting, sequence and observed result. Equipment access and WHS remain local teacher controls.
syllabus_content: Experimentation and proficiency in manufacturing techniques relevant to the MTP.
periods.evidence: Labelled samples and process record; H2.2, H4.2
periods.assessment_status: formative learning evidence; current formal task notice Teacher to confirm

periods.focus: Comparing samples and selecting a method
periods.student_work: Use functional, aesthetic and production criteria to compare samples. Students retain rejected evidence and justify the selected or revised technique.
syllabus_content: Evaluation of techniques and materials for MTP design and manufacture.
periods.evidence: Comparative evaluation and MTP technique decision; H1.1, H4.2
periods.assessment_status: formative learning evidence; current formal task notice Teacher to confirm

periods.student_work: Introduce the WWHS Hmong culture study through sourced context and careful language. Students distinguish evidence, inference and generalisation, recognising diversity within communities.
syllabus_content: Cultural factors influencing textile design and production; textiles as forms of cultural expression.
periods.evidence: Source-quality and respectful-language check; H6.1
periods.assessment_status: formative learning evidence; current formal task notice Teacher to confirm

periods.student_work: Students examine how location, available resources, skill, social context and processes can shape textile production. They record what is known and what must not be assumed.
syllabus_content: Relationship of cultural context, resources, skills and production processes to textile forms.
periods.evidence: Evidence map with uncertainty labels; H1.1, H6.1
periods.assessment_status: formative learning evidence; current formal task notice Teacher to confirm

periods.student_work: Model respectful influence through transferable design principles such as labour, layering, contrast or narrative structure—not copying culturally significant motifs. Students test one concept against this boundary.
syllabus_content: Cultural influence on design; ethical and respectful development of an individual MTP.
periods.evidence: Respectful-influence rationale and revised concept; H1.1, H1.2, H6.1
periods.assessment_status: formative learning evidence; current formal task notice Teacher to confirm

periods.student_work: Students audit citations, image permissions, captions and wording in their influence evidence. Unsupported cultural claims are removed or marked for teacher confirmation.
syllabus_content: Communication and management of source-grounded MTP design development.
periods.evidence: Cultural-evidence audit and next action; H2.1, H2.3, H6.1
periods.assessment_status: formative learning evidence; current formal task notice Teacher to confirm

periods.focus: Generating ideas and selecting a direction
periods.student_work: Generate meaningfully different ideas from the brief, then use explicit functional, aesthetic and feasibility criteria to select and defend a final direction.
syllabus_content: Visual design development, creativity and innovation in the MTP.
periods.evidence: Idea range, selection matrix and decision; H1.1, H1.2, H2.1
periods.assessment_status: formative learning evidence; current formal task notice Teacher to confirm

periods.student_work: Students unpack user, purpose, performance, comfort, appearance, style and context, then convert each requirement into a design response that can be observed or tested.
syllabus_content: Functional and aesthetic requirements of the MTP.
periods.evidence: Requirement-to-design-response table; H1.2
periods.assessment_status: formative learning evidence; current formal task notice Teacher to confirm

periods.student_work: Develop production drawings and technical/non-technical specifications suited to the project. Include only project-relevant dimensions, materials, notions and sequencing.
syllabus_content: Communication of design concepts and manufacturing specifications.
periods.evidence: Current drawing/specification set; H2.1
periods.assessment_status: formative learning evidence; current formal task notice Teacher to confirm

periods.student_work: Students convert the approved manufacture sequence into a living plan with dependencies, checkpoints and contingency actions. Current school milestones remain teacher-confirmed.
syllabus_content: Management of design and manufacture to completion.
periods.evidence: Versioned time/resource plan; H2.3
periods.assessment_status: formative learning evidence; current formal task notice Teacher to confirm

periods.focus: Building a fair and useful investigation
periods.student_work: Frame an investigation around an actual MTP decision. Define an aim, one purposeful variable, controls, a repeatable method and decision criteria for teacher approval.
syllabus_content: Investigation and experimentation supporting material, technique and process selection.
periods.evidence: Teacher-approvable investigation plan; H1.1, H4.1, H4.2
periods.assessment_status: formative learning evidence; current formal task notice Teacher to confirm

periods.student_work: Under local teacher direction, produce or analyse authorised samples. Record what occurred using photographs, labels, measurements or precise observations without back-filling an expected result.
syllabus_content: Accurate communication of experimentation and manufacturing evidence.
periods.evidence: Traceable sample/results record; H2.1, H2.2
periods.assessment_status: formative learning evidence; current formal task notice Teacher to confirm

periods.student_work: Compare evidence with the stated criteria, identify limitations and make a specific keep/change/reject decision. Link the decision to the brief and end use.
syllabus_content: Evaluation of experimentation and its contribution to MTP design and manufacture.
periods.evidence: Evidence-based design-change record; H1.1, H4.1, H4.2
periods.assessment_status: formative learning evidence; current formal task notice Teacher to confirm

periods.student_work: Students check that each experiment has a decision purpose, method, authentic evidence, evaluation and visible consequence. Plan the smallest remaining investigation.
syllabus_content: Management and communication of MTP investigation evidence.
periods.evidence: Experimentation audit and next investigation; H2.1, H2.3
periods.assessment_status: formative learning evidence; current formal task notice Teacher to confirm

periods.student_work: Distinguish invention, innovation and improvement. Analyse how performance needs, resource constraints, markets, research and social priorities can drive textile change.
syllabus_content: Nature and development of textile innovations and emerging technologies.
periods.evidence: Driver-to-innovation explanation; H3.2
periods.assessment_status: formative learning evidence; current formal task notice Teacher to confirm

periods.student_work: Compare current source-verified examples at fibre, yarn and fabric level. Trace how a structural change is intended to alter performance.
syllabus_content: Innovations in fibres, yarns and fabrics and their emerging applications.
periods.evidence: Structure-change-performance chain; H3.1, H3.2
periods.assessment_status: formative learning evidence; current formal task notice Teacher to confirm

periods.student_work: Evaluate an innovation from consumer, manufacturer, employee and environmental viewpoints. Students identify an MTP-relevant possibility but avoid unsupported novelty claims.
syllabus_content: Impacts of textile innovations on products, processes, people and environment.
periods.evidence: Multi-perspective impact evaluation; H3.2, H5.2
periods.assessment_status: formative learning evidence; current formal task notice Teacher to confirm

periods.student_work: Students investigate whether one emerging material or process is feasible and appropriate for their actual end use, resources and evidence needs. Record use, rejection or teacher-confirmation status.
syllabus_content: Selection and justification of materials, processes and equipment for the MTP.
periods.evidence: Feasibility and end-use decision; H1.1, H4.1, H4.2
periods.assessment_status: formative learning evidence; current formal task notice Teacher to confirm

periods.focus: Microfibres, bicomponent yarns and washable webs
periods.student_work: Teach the specified innovation types through structure, manufacture, claimed performance and end use. Students avoid treating every fine fibre or non-woven as the same technology.
syllabus_content: Microfibres, bicomponent yarns and washable webs as textile innovations.
periods.evidence: Three-technology comparison; H3.1, H3.2
periods.assessment_status: formative learning evidence; current formal task notice Teacher to confirm

periods.student_work: Retrieve Preliminary fibre, yarn and fabric knowledge, then diagnose weak links in a structure-to-property explanation before applying it to an HSC innovation.
syllabus_content: Interrelationship of fibre, yarn and fabric properties; continuity from Preliminary learning.
periods.evidence: Corrected structure-property reasoning chain; H3.1
periods.assessment_status: formative learning evidence; current formal task notice Teacher to confirm

periods.student_work: Start with an end-use requirement, identify the required property, connect it to structure and compare trade-offs. Apply the reasoning to one provisional MTP material.
syllabus_content: Selection of textiles for performance in specific end uses.
periods.evidence: End-use comparison and provisional selection; H3.1, H4.1
periods.assessment_status: formative learning evidence; current formal task notice Teacher to confirm

periods.student_work: Students verify fibre, yarn, fabric and finish information for selected materials and identify evidence gaps. Unsupported retail claims are not used as proof.
syllabus_content: Justification of textile selection for MTP functional and aesthetic requirements.
periods.evidence: Material evidence card and next test/source; H1.1, H4.1
periods.assessment_status: formative learning evidence; current formal task notice Teacher to confirm

periods.student_work: Compare how selected production machinery and computer-supported systems change precision, speed, repeatability, labour or design communication. Use current examples only when source-verified.
syllabus_content: Developments in textile machinery and computer-supported production.
periods.evidence: Technology-impact comparison; H3.2
periods.assessment_status: formative learning evidence; current formal task notice Teacher to confirm

periods.student_work: Analyse how removing or relocating seams alters production, fit, comfort, waste and design possibilities. Students distinguish a seamless process from simply hiding seams.
syllabus_content: Seamless technology and its effect on textile manufacture and performance.
periods.evidence: Process-performance explanation; H3.1, H3.2
periods.assessment_status: formative learning evidence; current formal task notice Teacher to confirm

periods.student_work: Under teacher direction, compare an authorised conventional and technology-supported enhancement pathway or sample. Evaluate the result against accuracy, time, surface effect and end use.
syllabus_content: Use of machinery and decorative technologies to enhance textile products.
periods.evidence: Comparative process evidence; H2.2, H4.2
periods.assessment_status: formative learning evidence; current formal task notice Teacher to confirm

periods.student_work: Students justify the selected equipment and manufacturing sequence for one MTP stage, including constraints, quality controls and an approved alternative if access changes.
syllabus_content: Selection and justification of manufacturing techniques, materials and equipment for the MTP.
periods.evidence: Technology decision and contingency; H2.3, H4.2
periods.assessment_status: formative learning evidence; current formal task notice Teacher to confirm

periods.student_work: Translate a use scenario into observable functional and aesthetic criteria before selecting a textile. Compare how priorities shift across two focus areas.
syllabus_content: Functional and aesthetic performance criteria for textile end uses.
periods.evidence: End-use criteria matrix; H1.2, H4.1
periods.assessment_status: formative learning evidence; current formal task notice Teacher to confirm

periods.student_work: Compare selected finishes by treatment, intended effect, limitations and care implications. Avoid absolute performance claims unless supported by a current source.
syllabus_content: Fabric finishing techniques, performance enhancement and care requirements.
periods.evidence: Finish-performance-care chain; H3.1, H4.1
periods.assessment_status: formative learning evidence; current formal task notice Teacher to confirm

periods.student_work: Build a full justification from fibre properties through yarn and fabric structure to finish, end-use performance and trade-offs.
syllabus_content: Interrelationship of fibre, yarn, fabric and finish in selection for specific end uses.
periods.evidence: Evidence-based selection response; H3.1, H4.1
periods.assessment_status: formative learning evidence; current formal task notice Teacher to confirm

periods.student_work: Students plan and write a supported response using an unfamiliar end-use scenario. Diagnose whether each sentence identifies, explains or justifies as required.
syllabus_content: Integrated Properties and Performance content applied to HSC-style questions.
periods.evidence: Timed formative response and feedback; H3.1, H3.2, H4.1
periods.assessment_status: formative learning evidence; current formal task notice Teacher to confirm

syllabus_content: Structure and sectors of the Australian textile industry and their relationships.
periods.evidence: Source-dated sector map; H5.2
area_hours: Australian Textiles, Clothing, Footwear and Allied Industries
periods.assessment_status: formative learning evidence; current formal task notice Teacher to confirm

periods.module_title: The Australian Textiles Industry and Marketplace
periods.student_work: Apply product, price, place and promotion to an approved textile case. Connect target market and product life-cycle position to marketing decisions.
syllabus_content: Textile marketplace, target markets, product development, marketing mix and product life cycle.
periods.evidence: Marketing strategy analysis; H5.1
area_hours: Australian Textiles, Clothing, Footwear and Allied Industries
periods.assessment_status: formative learning evidence; current formal task notice Teacher to confirm

periods.module_title: The Australian Textiles Industry and Marketplace
periods.student_work: Analyse how global supply, consumer demand, skills and workplace decisions interact. Students identify one relevant implication for communicating their MTP as a product.
syllabus_content: Globalisation, skills, consumer demand and changing industry relationships.
periods.evidence: Relationship analysis and MTP implication; H5.1, H5.2
area_hours: Australian Textiles, Clothing, Footwear and Allied Industries
periods.assessment_status: formative learning evidence; current formal task notice Teacher to confirm

periods.module_title: The Australian Textiles Industry and Marketplace
periods.focus: MTP product communication and label planning
periods.student_work: Students draft product information appropriate to user and end use, then flag every legal, fibre-content, care or school requirement that needs current teacher/source confirmation.
